source.title: My Qualifications - Neon Electrical
source.content:
Master Electrician
Being a registered member of Master Electricians New Zealand means my work meets the highest industry standards, and every residential job I complete is backed by a $20,000 Workmanship Guarantee. This guarantee ensures that if any issues arise within 12 months, they will be investigated and rectified at no extra cost—so you can trust that your electrical work is done right, every time.
Public liability insurance
I take your safety and security seriously. That’s why Neon Electrical is backed by a $5 million Public Liability Insurance policy, ensuring that you’re fully protected in the unlikely event of accidental damage or issues arising from electrical work. This coverage, underwritten by AIG Insurance New Zealand Limited, provides peace of mind for both residential and commercial clients.
